ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels; distinct high-contrast boundaries between pigmentation zones.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white regions on the lateral lobes separated by a central black peduncle-to-notch chevron; black pigmentation frames the entire trailing edge and central fluke body.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured acute angle and significant vertical pixel depth separating the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; amplitude of serrations increases towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve extending from the median notch to sharp, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; sparse circular white points on the black central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel dark vertical striations (rake marks) on the left white lobe; distinct intersecting diagonal dark lines forming an 'X' or 'Y' shape on the right white lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent multi-linear rake marks on the left lobe and a large intersecting scar on the right lobe; irregular notch morphology suggests minor tissue degradation.
other_distinctive_markers: A long, isolated horizontal black line extending from the central black pigment into the lower-left white patch.
